segments.text: How do you cool a phone with no fan?
Since the iPhone 17 Pro, there's a vapor chamber:
a flat metal pocket with a little pure water sealed inside,
On the iPhone 18 Pro, it's three times bigger.
Apple says that's forty percent more speed when things get hot.
Fun fact: gaming Android phones had one back in 2018.
